Read link's parent table, held to the two builds it joins

Source: R/parent_read.R
knw_parent_read.Rd

link#444 writes <schema>.streams_parent: one row per segment of the full network, naming the minimal-network segment it lies in (cut-min), with that parent's gradient and length and how much of the full segment lies on another minimal segment (straddle_m). This reads it for knw_parent_join() (#120), after checking that it describes the two builds in the database now, because a re-model of either network leaves the table behind:

  • the table names one minimal build, minimal_schema's, by schema and run (schema_minimal, run_uid_minimal);

  • each group's run_id_full is a row of <schema>.log for that group from a run <schema>.log_recompute names, and each run_id_minimal a row of <minimal_schema>.log from the minimal build's run;

  • every segment of <schema>.streams has exactly one parent row, and each row's overlap_m + straddle_m is its segment's length within 1 cm.

Usage

knw_parent_read(conn, schema, minimal_schema = NULL, keys = NULL)

Arguments

conn

a DBI connection.

schema

character(1) the full network's persist schema, which holds streams_parent.

minimal_schema

character(1) or NULL: the minimal network's schema. NULL takes the one the table names, which must be one.

keys

NULL, or a data.frame with watershed_group_code and id_segment: read only those segments' rows (the checks still cover the whole table).

Value

A data.frame with knw_parent_join()'s columns (id_segment, wsg, id_segment_minimal, gradient_minimal, length_minimal, overlap_m, straddle_m), and attribute provenance: a one-row data.frame with schema, minimal_schema, run_uid_full, run_uid_minimal, link_sha_minimal, config_hash_minimal, built_at (the latest) and rows (the table's).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres())
p <- knw_parent_read(conn, "fresh_default", "fresh_default_minimal",
                     keys = data.frame(watershed_group_code = "BULK", id_segment = 1:10))
attr(p, "provenance")
} # }
